t: The Sovereign Technologist: Building Forever Machines in the Age of AI
s: This article outlines a methodology for technologists to build 'Forever Machines' and reclaim agency in the Age of AI, combating systemic AI forgetting and 'enshittification'. It emphasizes 'Context Engineering' and leveraging quantized AI models for persistent knowledge management and personal resilience.
sub: Ephemeral nature of AI and human cognition (garbage collection)
Inefficiency and cost of agentic frameworks using Mr. Meeseeks metaphor
Building home AI labs with quantized models (GGML/GGUF) for sovereignty
"Desert Kite" / "Prompt Fu" for comprehensive, parallel context engineering
